Aurum Muriaticum Kalinatum.

Double Chloride of Potassium and Gold. K. Cl, Au Cl3, 2H2O.

Clinical.─Uterus, hæmorrhage from; induration of.

Characteristics.─An unproved salt, recommended by Dr. Burford and others as the best preparation of gold in cases of uterine induration and hæmorrhage.

Relations.─Compare: Aur. mur. nat., Hydrastinin. mur.
